I also draw a lot in this deck, and we can find value in symmetrical wheels that achieve both oppoinent and my card draw... but my card draw needs to be converted into drain/or draw/or something... and we can refactor the deck along those two lines... anything that makes the tithe infinites more likely is good too

contributions.text:
Study 005 (heliod / b3-v1), 12 candidates in W, U or colourless, none in the list. None forms a two-card infinite (combos_raw.json.gz, variants of 3 or fewer against b3-v1); Windfall forms a two-card NON-infinite "win the game" line with Approach of the Second Sun. No mill or Laboratory-Maniac cards (Psychic Corrosion, Sphinx's Tutelage, Teferi's Tutelage dropped).

(A) Converters. 1 Monument to Endurance {3}: whenever you discard, choose one not chosen this turn — draw a card; create a Treasure; each opponent loses 3 life (turns every wheel's discard into drain). Not GC; seen. 2 Consecrated Sphinx {4}{U}{U}: whenever an opponent draws, you may draw two. GC (the branch is at three). Seen. 3 Smuggler's Share {2}{W}: each end step, draw for each opponent who drew two or more this turn; Treasure for each with two or more lands entering. Not GC; seen. 4 Tataru Taru {1}{W}: ETB you draw, target opponent may draw; whenever an opponent draws off their turn, a tapped Treasure (once a turn). Not GC; seen. 5 Mind's Eye {5}: pay {1} per opponent draw to draw — staged in and reverted 2026-11-13 by the pilot ("per-card tax competed with the discount"). 6 Struggle for Project Purity {3}{U}: Brotherhood — each opponent draws at your upkeep, you draw that many. Invisible. 7 Teferi, Temporal Pilgrim {3}{U}{U}: loyalty per draw; weak converter.
(B) Wheels. 8 Windfall {2}{U}: each player discards and draws the greatest number; does NOT shuffle; invisible; 78.8% of bracket-3 Heliod lists (recon). 9 Jace's Archivist {1}{U}{U}: {U},{T} repeatable Windfall; does NOT shuffle. 10 Timetwister {2}{U}: SHUFFLES hand and graveyard into the library — moves Approach out of its seventh-from-the-top slot (also Time Reversal, Day's Undoing, Echo of Eons — all shuffle). 11 Jace Beleren {1}{U}{U}: +2 each player draws a card; does not shuffle; invisible.
(C) Tithe infinites. 12 Enlightened Tutor {W}: artifact/enchantment to top (Tithe, Splendor, Mirrormade) — GC (a fourth) and SHUFFLES. Alternatives Idyllic Tutor, Moon-Blessed Cleric (enchantments, shuffle). No other redundant piece found.

Design: b3-v1 turned to two lines (read-only). Three swaps are clear; the rest NO CHANGE. [M] one instrument, [N] arithmetic from oracle text, [A] argument.
1. Shape. Line 2 has one converter, Psychosis Crawler: no other W/U/colourless "whenever you draw" card drains or damages (the rest grow a body or mill, and mill is out by the pilot's rule) [A]; a body hits one seat where Crawler drains each (strategy:conversion.yield), so: one converter found reliably (strategy:conversion.availability) plus doublers and bursts. Kill sizing [N]: three opponents at 40 need 40 of our draws with Crawler out; one doubler (Teferi's Ageless Insight, Bard) makes it 20, two make it 10; Mathemagics X=4 draws 16 (32 doubled). Drip (Mine, Dictate, Font ~5 a turn, ~9 under Insight) is a clock of 4-8 turns; the kill is a burst turn with Crawler out (strategy:card-advantage.plan-draw). Wheels feed both lines [A]: their draws are discount, Treasure, Mastermind and Rhystic cards, Scrawling life; ours are Psychosis drain; a non-shuffling wheel at seven cards pulls Approach's seventh slot into hand. Dangers [N]: any shuffle after Approach's first cast displaces it (Day's Undoing, Echo of Eons, Time Spiral, Timetwister, a cracked fetch, tutoring for anything else) — play shuffles before Approach is set; Windfall discards our hand, Approach included; decking (library ~92; a doubled Mathemagics can exceed it); Venser recasts a bounced Approach (combo 553-3634, needs a stack scenario).
2. Cuts: no combat body is left to cut. Weakest: Sapphire Medallion (Approach is white; the discount does the cost work); Greater Auramancy (targeted-removal shield only; Clever Concealment and Dawn's Truce cover wipes; pilot added it 2026-09); Soul-Guide Lantern (the pilot's "only graveyard answer", 2026-11-13 — cut only if he accepts that).
3. Adds (none a Game Changer; b3-v1 holds three: Mystical Tutor, Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe): Windfall [M: kill by T10 60.7 -> 61.2, no call; extra cards by T8 +0.58 [+0.49,+0.67]; hoard @T10 1.60 -> 3.31; damage @T10 -0.19; dead wheels @T5 +0.066]; Alhammarret's Archive (a third doubler; cut by the pilot 2026-09-20 for Gleaming Splendor — his call); Scour for Scrap (finds Psychosis Crawler and the doublers; strategy:conversion.availability); Idyllic Tutor (Tithe, Mirrormade, Splendor); Muddle the Mixture (transmutes to Faerie Mastermind or Splendor); Recruiter of the Guard, The Seriema; Words of Wisdom, Cut a Deal (Cut a Deal went to Fascination 2026-11-13); Jace's Archivist, Thought Reflection. Held: Aetherflux Reservoir, Triskaidekaphile (an alternate win — ask). Tithe infinites need opponents who won't pay {2} (authored 50%); more pieces raise assembly, not that brake.
4. Order (one at a time; NO CHANGE valid; strategy:conversion.substitution): 1 Sapphire Medallion -> Windfall; 2 Greater Auramancy -> Alhammarret's Archive (needs a stack scenario before trusting a count); 3 Soul-Guide Lantern -> Scour for Scrap (only if he gives up the Lantern's job); 4+ no clear OUT. Keep 35 lands.
Open: a stack scenario for Insight with Bard and Archive, and Mathemagics against library size; how Forge pods pay Tithe's {2}.

call.pilot_words: approve! [Windfall for Sapphire Medallion] / ok.. no monument, it's not a fit; also, this is not a wheels deck, per se / greater auramancy is protection on heliod, which is critical... I don't like this [Alhammarret's Archive declined] / heliod is an approach deck... my card draw is for finding approach and quickly casting it a 2nd time
call.reading: Windfall replaces Sapphire Medallion on b3-v1: a non-shuffling symmetric draw that feeds Heliod's discount and the Treasure and draw payoffs without moving Approach from its slot. Monument to Endurance declined (the deck barely discards; not a wheels deck). Alhammarret's Archive declined: Greater Auramancy gives Heliod, an enchantment creature, shroud, and protects the enchantment engine. The drain-on-our-draws line was set aside: Psychosis Crawler is its only converter in these colours. The pilot reframed the second line as game-winning discounts, opened as its own study.
